items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Hagrid Farm crop sprite atlas, ONE species only: Mimbulus mimbletonia. Reference image is only the existing game's pixel-art style and ground pivot, not a subject to copy. Create a clearly GREY cactus-like squat magical plant with swollen rounded lobes and boils instead of spines; no orange mushroom caps, no flowers. Cozy chunky pixel clusters, selective dark plum contour, upper-left light, 2:1 dimetric angle. Transparent alpha background, no labels/text, no border. Exactly FOUR rows with FOUR equal cells per row: row1 four growth stages seedling/tiny/young/mature; row2 four distinct mature idle poses subtle swelling and slight foliage breathing, fixed root; row3 first four care/action poses prepare/swell/lean/green stinksap release; row4 first TWO cells recovery/settle, last TWO cells fully transparent empty. Fourteen complete separate silhouettes total. Each cell has at least25% transparent space on all sides, roots same baseline in each row; no detached particles crossing gutters. All mature frames same scale and grey identity. Designed to be sampled to64x96 canvas, plant ink <=50x60 pixels.
